title: Sources say Automattic's board is out after failed attempt to oust CEO Matt Mullenweg | TechCrunch
summary: After the vote, Mullenweg, the WordPress founder and CEO of WordPress.com parent company Automattic, accused the board of conspiring against him in a post on Automattic’s Slack. Automattic confirmed to TechCrunch on Saturday that he had returned.
